assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single Hearts of Iron IV national-focus game icon for the alternate-history Lithuanian-Belarusian Union LTB, circa 1936. Primary request: one polished hand-painted military-strategy UI emblem, richly shaded embossed bronze and aged gold trim, muted steel, deep crimson accents, ivory-red-ivory ceremonial ribbon. Composition: one compact symmetrical centered emblem occupying 78% of a square canvas, generously separated from all edges. Fine but readable at 95 pixels, strong clear silhouette, bold central symbol, subtle historical metal texture, frontal view, soft upper-left highlights. Genuinely transparent background; no backdrop, no checkerboard, no landscape, no text, no numerals, no letters, no watermark. No Nazi imagery, no modern logos. Match the existing HOI4 focus style and LTB heraldic white mounted-knight motif. Subject: two distinct small heraldic red shields, each containing an ivory mounted knight, united by clasped hands, backed by a compact golden laurel wreath. Symbolizes strengthening the Lithuanian-Belarusian Union. Keep the handshake and two shields clear.
